description: DCPower-ICS: A Labeled ICS Anomaly Detection Dataset for Data Center Power Infrastructure is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Vahid Heydari (Morgan State University). DCPower-ICS is a fully synthetic, labeled industrial control system anomaly-detection benchmark for data-center power infrastructure. It covers utility feed, PCC breaker, ATS, backup generators, BESS, UPS, IT load, cooling load, and sheddable load using a reduced-order, physics-informed simulator. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
